title: Halo Dental header
description: Transparent dark overlay top navigation bar with a slanted double-oval mark and wordmark on the left, six centred text links, and a white rectangular CTA paired with square language and accessibility buttons on the right. Includes a native <details> burger menu on mobile.
notes: overlay (on by default) positions the bar inside the top of the rounded dark hero
tone defaults to dark so the header keeps its crisp white-on-black contrast regardless of page mode
name: halodental-header

props.name: overlay
